caption: The drawing features a single piece of intricately detailed lace, depicted in grayscale tones. The lace is shown in a fan-like trapezoidal shape, wider at the bottom and tapering toward the top, oriented on a plain, light-colored background. The top portion consists of a fine, closely-woven mesh with subtle shading, while the central section displays a dense arrangement of floral and botanical motifs, including leaves, branches, clusters of berries, and stylized flowers. The lower edge of the lace is adorned with a scalloped border, featuring circular eyelets and dense embroidered patterns. The bottommost section illustrates a more open, net-like lace design with intricate floral elements. The name “Erwin Schwabe” is inscribed in small letters in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Embroidered Cuff
